{{Top|leg}}
'''Ovpi Urgon''' was a [[Banker/Legends|banker]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Urgon was a manager of [[Mos Espa Valid]], a [[Bank/Legends|bank]] based in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]].<ref name="SWG:Ttgp">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=space|Time to get paid|Yavin system}}</ref>
